subject: reasoning
question: Atul starts from point A and drives 9 km towards the west. He then turns left, drives 8 km, then turns left again and drives 15 km. He then turns left again and drives 16 km. He finally turns left, drives 6 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction must he drive to reach point A again? (Unless specified, all turns are 90 degrees only)
solution:
Given:

Atul starts from point A and drives 9 km towards the west. He then turns left, drives 8 km, then turns left again and drives 15 km. He then turns left again and drives 16 km. He finally turns left, drives 6 km and stops at point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/064e4c66da33d1986eaa42873b48063c24f52adadb4307199929ec87acd8cba2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a1ccc6c6c80f29a300a9fbaad704656c8c807a543ce0f407edfd2de0bf5b02f.png] 

To reach point A from point P, he must drive **8 km to the South**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
